name: Inkwll
tagline: Enterprise-grade scheduling for the modern tattoo enterprise.
positioning: Inkwll is the booking and operations platform that helps multi-location tattoo studios manage artists, deposits, and consent at scale.

hero.h1: The operating system for tattoo studios at scale.
hero.sub: Inkwll unifies bookings, deposits, consent forms, and artist payouts across every chair in every location — so your studio runs like the enterprise it's becoming.

features.title: Multi-location booking
features.description: Route clients to the right artist and chair across all your studios from one calendar, with real-time availability and automated deposit collection.

features.title: Digital consent vault
features.description: Capture signed consent, aftercare acknowledgments, and ID verification per session — retained, timestamped, and audit-ready for compliance teams.

features.title: Artist payout engine
features.description: Split commissions, guest-artist rates, and chair rentals automatically. Payouts reconcile against every session down to the milliliter of ink.

features.title: Portfolio-driven matching
features.description: Let clients discover artists by style, healed work, and availability — then convert browsing into booked, deposit-secured appointments.

features.title: Studio analytics
features.description: Track chair utilization, no-show rates, and revenue per artist with dashboards built for owners running ten or a hundred locations.

features.title: Compliance automation
features.description: Stay ahead of health-department requirements with license tracking, sterilization logs, and renewal alerts across jurisdictions.

testimonials.quote: Before Inkwll we ran fourteen studios on eleven spreadsheets. Now deposits, consent, and payouts reconcile automatically. Our chair utilization jumped nineteen percent in a quarter.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The consent vault alone passed our legal review in one meeting. Inkwll turned compliance from a liability into a competitive advantage across every location.
testimonials.name: Declan Rowe

testimonials.quote: Usage-based pricing meant we onboarded all thirty locations without a painful upfront contract. We pay for booked sessions, not empty promises.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
